# Lautaro Gärtner's blog

This agent bundle was generated from a public website.

## Source

https://lautarogartner.com/

## Description

Personal site for Lautaro Gärtner and Paideia Framework.

## Routes

- /: Lautaro Gärtner's blog
- /about: About - Lautaro Gärtner
- /building-paideia: Building Paideia: Software That Explains Itself - Lautaro Gärtner
- /framework-becomes-a-tool: The Moment a Framework Becomes a Tool - Lautaro Gärtner
- /generated-systems-should-explain-themselves: Why Generated Systems Should Explain Themselves - Lautaro Gärtner

## Files

- system.json: discovered site contract
- runtime.json: generation identity and artifact inventory
- context.json: compact route and metadata summary
- llms.txt: plain-language entrypoint

## Limits

This v0.3 prototype fetches the homepage and up to 10 same-origin pages linked from it. It does not crawl recursively beyond the homepage link set.
